text:
sasha: FYI — Sales opened a private deployment request from Heliotrope Financial. They want VPC + on-prem connector, strict egress controls, and HSM for key custody. Asking for an estimate and must-have checklist.

 tom-sales: Heliotrope is a mid-market finserv customer. Primary ask: full isolation, model pinning to a vetted 13B, audit logs for every request, and PCI adjacency requirements. They want a pilot in ~8 weeks if we can do it.

 sasha: Can we get an initial feasibility: what are the blockers on infra/security/ML ops? Keep it scoped — pilot can be single-region, single-model, limited QPS.

 raj-eng-infra: Quick notes: we can do VPC peering or private link; on-prem connector requires their subnet and a NAT-free path. KMS integration: we support Cloud KMS and AWS HSM but on-prem HSM integration will be custom. Network ACLs + firewall rules list below.

 raj-eng-infra: ```
Required firewall:
- allow outbound to control-plane-ip:443 (customer->redwood control plane) only from mgmt host
- inbound TCP 9000 from local infra for model inference (if using connector)
- block all other egress
```

 maria-eng-ml: ML notes: model pinning OK. For 13B we recommend a 4-bit quantized variant to hit throughput targets on their hardware; need to validate quality on their dataset. KV cache persistence across restarts is possible but depend on their storage mount.

 jordana-security: Security checklist draft:
- KMS / HSM integration defined and tested
- Customer-provided or managed machine identity (we prefer customer-managed certs)
- Audit logging to their SIEM (syslog/HTTPS endpoint)
- No outbound internet from inference nodes (allowlist only)
- Contractually: SOC2 + PCI scoping addendum

 elaine-solutions: Ops concerns: who will run the initial runbook? Solutions can run the first week of pilot (hand-holding) but we need a signed support addendum. Also need customer infra contact and maintenance window cadence.

 sasha: Good. Can someone surface a minimal launch acceptance criteria list (3–5 items) we can present to Sales? Pilot acceptance should be narrow.

 maria-eng-ml: Proposed pilot acceptance criteria: 1) model version pinned and serving with <120ms median token latency at 5 RPS, 2) responses pass 90% of baseline eval prompt set (we'll run their small eval), 3) end-to-end audit logs delivered to customer endpoint, 4) failover fallback to hosted variant if connector offline (for demo only).

 raj-eng-infra: Infrastructure acceptance: 1) network path and firewall validated, 2) KMS/HSM key wrap tested in staging, 3) deployment infra automated via our helm + operator and reproducible.

 jordana-security: Add: penetration test checklist item or at least a scoping call prior to pilot sign-off. Also require subprocessor disclosure for any third-party infra.

 tom-sales: Customer constraints: no external model telemetry; they will not accept PII out of the box. They asked for timeline commitment — I told them ~8–12 weeks contingent on HSM work.

 sasha: Risks: HSM integration and audit endpoint delivery are highest risk. Log delivery formats differ per SIEM — consider building a thin adaptor in the pilot.

 raj-eng-infra: ETA for infra work if greenlit: 4 weeks to provision VPC connector + KMS test, additional 2–3 weeks for HSM integration and hardened network rules. Needs 2 engineers + 0.5 PM.

 maria-eng-ml: ETA for model validation and quantization QC: 2 weeks once we have a sample dataset and access to customer acceptance harness.

 elaine-solutions: Action items for Sales before we build: - customer infra contact and test account - signed pilot SOW + support addendum - SIEM endpoint details and certs - list of test prompts for eval

 tom-sales: I'll get the infra contact and push for SOW this week. Customer agrees to provide sample prompts and a small dataset (anonymized).

 sasha: Cool. Who owns the intake doc to add to backlog? I'll create the product ticket if someone posts the minimal checklist and risks here.

 raj-eng-infra: I'll drop a short infra checklist in the ticket later today.

 maria-eng-ml: I'll prepare the eval harness template and a quantization risk note.

 jordana-security: I'll book a 30-min scoping call with customer security and share PT scope.

 deploy-bot: deployment-checklist created: PROD-INTAKE-4789 (link: https://redwood.internal/ops/PROD-INTAKE-4789) :white_check_mark:

 sasha: Thanks all — assigning owners in the ticket now. Expect follow-ups in the ticket and a scoping call invite. :+1:
